test_title: PYST 9: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 22 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

We should __enjoyed playing__ all sorts of games.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the verb form should be corrected.
 
• The correct verb form should be **'enjoy playing'** instead of **'enjoyed playing'**.
 
• Therefore, the correct verb form should be 'enjoy playing' instead of 'enjoyed playing'.

Hence, the correct sentence is** "*We should enjoy __playing all sorts of games*."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• In English grammar, the verb should agree with the subject in number and person.
 
• In sentences with modal verbs like 'should', the base form of the verb is used.
 
 
• **Example:** *We should **enjoy** the journey.*
